description: Two players alternately take the leftmost or rightmost pile. The number of piles is even and their total is odd. Return whether the first player wins with optimal play.
intuition: Store the best score advantage for each interval. Taking either end gains that pile but subtracts the opponent’s best advantage on the remaining interval.
